import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Weight of the (unique, by the simple-graph precondition) edge `u → v`. -/
def bfEdgeW (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 == v)).map (fun p => p.2)

/-- `⊤`-aware minimum: `none` plays the role of `+∞`. -/
def bfOmin (x : Option Int) (y : Int) : Option Int :=
  match x with
  | none => some y
  | some a => some (min a y)

/-- Relax the single edge `u → v` against the accumulator. -/
def bfRelax1 (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat)
    (u : Nat) (acc : Option Int) : Option Int :=
  match d.getD u none, bfEdgeW g u v with
  | some du, some c => bfOmin acc (du + c)
  | _, _ => acc

/-- New distance of `v` after one relaxation round. -/
def bfRelaxAt (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  (List.range g.size).foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) (d.getD v none)

/-- One full Bellman-Ford relaxation round over all edges. -/
def bfStep (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Option Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).map (bfRelaxAt g d)

def bfInit (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : List (Option Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).map (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none)

def bfIter (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => bfInit g start
  | k + 1 => bfStep g (bfIter g start k)

/-- `x ≤ y` where `none` means `+∞`. -/
def bfOLe (x y : Option Int) : Prop := ∀ b, y = some b → ∃ a, x = some a ∧ a ≤ b
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bellman_ford (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)) = bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1) then
    some (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))
  else
    none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : Option (List (Option Int)))
    (_ : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dists =>
      dists.length = graph.size ∧
      ∀ v, v < graph.size →
        match dists.getD v none with
        | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
        | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  | none =>
      graph.has_negative_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

/-! ### List plumbing -/

theorem bf_getD_map_range (f : Nat → Option Int) (n v : Nat) (h : v < n) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD v none = f v := by
  have h1 : ((List.range n).map f)[v]? = some (f v) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_map]
    simp [h]
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h1]

theorem bf_getD_map_range_ge (f : Nat → Option Int) (n v : Nat) (h : n ≤ v) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD v none = none := by
  have h1 : ((List.range n).map f)[v]? = none := by
    rw [List.getElem?_map]
    simp
    omega
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h1]

theorem bf_list_ext_getD (l1 l2 : List (Option Int)) (hl : l1.length = l2.length)
    (h : ∀ v, v < l1.length → l1.getD v none = l2.getD v none) : l1 = l2 := by
  apply List.ext_getElem hl
  intro i h1 h2
  have := h i h1
  rwa [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h2] at this

theorem bf_last_mem : ∀ (l : List Nat) (v : Nat), l.getLast? = some v → v ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro v h; simp at h
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro v h
    cases t with
    | nil => simp at h; simp [h]
    | cons z t' =>
      rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at h
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih v h)

theorem bf_getLast_concat : ∀ (l : List Nat) (v : Nat), l.getLast? = some v →
    ∃ l', l = l' ++ [v] := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro v h; simp at h
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro v h
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp at h; simp [h]⟩
    | cons z t' =>
      rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at h
      obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := ih v h
      exact ⟨y :: l', by simp [hl']⟩

theorem bf_head?_append_cons (a : List Nat) (x : Nat) (b : List Nat) :
    (a ++ x :: b).head? = (a ++ [x]).head? := by
  cases a <;> simp

theorem bf_getLast?_append_cons (a : List Nat) (x : Nat) (b : List Nat) :
    (a ++ x :: b).getLast? = (x :: b).getLast? := by
  induction a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => simp [List.getLast?_cons_cons]
    | cons z t' =>
      have : (y :: z :: t') ++ x :: b = y :: ((z :: t') ++ x :: b) := rfl
      rw [this]
      have h2 : (z :: t') ++ x :: b = z :: (t' ++ x :: b) := rfl
      rw [h2, List.getLast?_cons_cons, ← h2, ih]

theorem bf_not_nodup_decomp : ∀ (l : List Nat), ¬ l.Nodup →
    ∃ (a : List Nat) (x : Nat) (b c : List Nat), l = a ++ x :: b ++ x :: c := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd List.nodup_nil h
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro h
    by_cases hy : y ∈ t
    · obtain ⟨s, r, hs⟩ := List.append_of_mem hy
      exact ⟨[], y, s, r, by simp [hs]⟩
    · have ht : ¬ t.Nodup := by
        intro hnd
        exact h (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hy, hnd⟩)
      obtain ⟨a, x, b, c, hab⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨y :: a, x, b, c, by simp [hab]⟩

theorem bf_nodup_bound (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x < n) (hnd : l.Nodup) :
    l.length ≤ n := by
  have h1 : l.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (h x hx)
  have h2 := Finset.card_le_card h1
  rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd, Finset.card_range] at h2
  exact h2

/-! ### Walk algebra -/

theorem bf_isPath_single (g : WeightedGraph) (u : Nat) : g.is_path [u] := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]

theorem bf_isPath_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (r : List Nat) :
    g.is_path (u :: v :: r) ↔ (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: r) := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]

theorem bf_weight_single (g : WeightedGraph) (u : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight [u] w ↔ w = 0 := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

theorem bf_weight_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (r : List Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (u :: v :: r) w ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge u v we ∧ g.path_has_weight (v :: r) wr ∧ w = we + wr := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

theorem bf_weight_exists (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat), g.is_path p →
    ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; exact ⟨0, by simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]⟩
  | cons a t iht =>
    intro hp
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, (bf_weight_single g a 0).mpr rfl⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      rw [bf_isPath_cons2] at hp
      obtain ⟨⟨we, hwe⟩, hpt⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := iht hpt
      exact ⟨we + wr, (bf_weight_cons2 g a b t' _).mpr ⟨we, wr, hwe, hwr, rfl⟩⟩

theorem bf_split_path (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (a : List Nat) (x : Nat) (b : List Nat) (w : Int),
    g.is_path (a ++ x :: b) → g.path_has_weight (a ++ x :: b) w →
    ∃ w1 w2, g.is_path (a ++ [x]) ∧ g.path_has_weight (a ++ [x]) w1 ∧
             g.is_path (x :: b) ∧ g.path_has_weight (x :: b) w2 ∧ w = w1 + w2 := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil =>
    intro x b w hp hw
    refine ⟨0, w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, by ring⟩
    · simpa using bf_isPath_single g x
    · simp [bf_weight_single]
    · simpa using hp
    · simpa using hw
  | cons y a ih =>
    intro x b w hp hw
    cases a with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at hp hw ⊢
      rw [bf_isPath_cons2] at hp
      rw [bf_weight_cons2] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hed, hwr, hwe⟩ := hw
      refine ⟨we, wr, ?_, ?_, hp.2, hwr, hwe⟩
      · rw [bf_isPath_cons2]
        exact ⟨hp.1, bf_isPath_single g x⟩
      · rw [bf_weight_cons2]
        exact ⟨we, 0, hed, (bf_weight_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by ring⟩
    | cons z a' =>
      simp only [List.cons_append] at hp hw ⊢
      rw [bf_isPath_cons2] at hp
      rw [bf_weight_cons2] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hed, hwr, hwe⟩ := hw
      obtain ⟨w1, w2, hp1, hw1, hp2, hw2, hsum⟩ := ih x b wr hp.2 hwr
      refine ⟨we + w1, w2, ?_, ?_, hp2, hw2, by rw [hwe, hsum]; ring⟩
      · rw [bf_isPath_cons2]
        exact ⟨hp.1, hp1⟩
      · rw [bf_weight_cons2]
        exact ⟨we, w1, hed, hw1, rfl⟩

theorem bf_join_path (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (a : List Nat) (x : Nat) (b : List Nat) (w1 w2 : Int),
    g.is_path (a ++ [x]) → g.path_has_weight (a ++ [x]) w1 →
    g.is_path (x :: b) → g.path_has_weight (x :: b) w2 →
    g.is_path (a ++ x :: b) ∧ g.path_has_weight (a ++ x :: b) (w1 + w2) := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil =>
    intro x b w1 w2 _ hw1 hp2 hw2
    simp only [List.nil_append] at *
    rw [bf_weight_single] at hw1
    subst hw1
    exact ⟨hp2, by simpa using hw2⟩
  | cons y a ih =>
    intro x b w1 w2 hp1 hw1 hp2 hw2
    cases a with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at *
      rw [bf_isPath_cons2] at hp1
      rw [bf_weight_cons2] at hw1
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hed, hwr, hwe⟩ := hw1
      rw [bf_weight_single] at hwr
      constructor
      · rw [bf_isPath_cons2]; exact ⟨hp1.1, hp2⟩
      · rw [bf_weight_cons2]
        exact ⟨we, w2, hed, hw2, by rw [hwe, hwr]; ring⟩
    | cons z a' =>
      simp only [List.cons_append] at *
      rw [bf_isPath_cons2] at hp1
      rw [bf_weight_cons2] at hw1
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hed, hwr, hwe⟩ := hw1
      obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := ih x b wr w2 hp1.2 hwr hp2 hw2
      constructor
      · rw [bf_isPath_cons2]; exact ⟨hp1.1, hq1⟩
      · rw [bf_weight_cons2]
        exact ⟨we, wr + w2, hed, hq2, by rw [hwe]; ring⟩

theorem bf_verts_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u : Nat), g.is_path p → p.head? = some u → u < g.size →
      ∀ x ∈ p, x < g.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u _ h _ _ hx; simp at hx
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro u hp hh hu x hx
    simp at hh
    subst hh
    cases t with
    | nil => simp at hx; omega
    | cons z t' =>
      rw [bf_isPath_cons2] at hp
      obtain ⟨w, hed⟩ := hp.1
      obtain ⟨hy, pair, hmem, hp1, _⟩ := hed
      have hz : z < g.size := by
        have := (hwf y hy).1 pair hmem
        omega
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
      · omega
      · exact ih z hp.2 rfl hz x h

/-! ### Edge lookup -/

theorem bf_edgeW_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (c : Int) (hu : u < g.size)
    (h : bfEdgeW g u v = some c) : g.has_edge u v c := by
  unfold bfEdgeW at h
  cases hf : (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 == v) with
  | none => rw [hf] at h; simp at h
  | some p =>
    rw [hf] at h
    simp at h
    have hmem : p ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
    have hfd := List.find?_some hf
    simp at hfd
    refine ⟨hu, p, ?_, hfd, h⟩
    simpa using hmem

theorem bf_edgeW_complete (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (u v : Nat) (c : Int)
    (h : g.has_edge u v c) : bfEdgeW g u v = some c := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hmem, hp1, hp2⟩ := h
  have hmemL : pair ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by simpa using hmem
  cases hf : (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 == v) with
  | none =>
    exfalso
    have := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf pair hmemL
    simp [hp1] at this
  | some q =>
    have hqmem : q ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
    have hq1' := List.find?_some hf
    simp at hq1'
    have hq1 : q.1 = v := hq1'
    have := (hwf u hu).2 q pair (by simpa using hqmem) hmem (by rw [hq1, hp1])
    unfold bfEdgeW
    rw [hf]
    simp [this, hp2]

/-! ### Fold algebra -/

theorem bf_OLe_refl (x : Option Int) : bfOLe x x := by
  intro b hb; exact ⟨b, hb, le_refl b⟩

theorem bf_OLe_trans {x y z : Option Int} (h1 : bfOLe x y) (h2 : bfOLe y z) : bfOLe x z := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := h2 b hb
  obtain ⟨a', ha', ha'a⟩ := h1 a ha
  exact ⟨a', ha', le_trans ha'a hab⟩

theorem bf_omin_le_left (x : Option Int) (y : Int) : bfOLe (bfOmin x y) x := by
  intro b hb
  cases x with
  | none => simp at hb
  | some a =>
    have ha : a = b := by simpa using hb
    refine ⟨min a y, by simp [bfOmin], ?_⟩
    rw [← ha]
    exact min_le_left _ _

theorem bf_omin_le_right (x : Option Int) (y : Int) : bfOLe (bfOmin x y) (some y) := by
  intro b hb
  have hb' : y = b := by simpa using hb
  cases x with
  | none => exact ⟨y, by simp [bfOmin], le_of_eq hb'⟩
  | some a =>
    refine ⟨min a y, by simp [bfOmin], ?_⟩
    rw [← hb']
    exact min_le_right _ _

theorem bf_omin_sound (x : Option Int) (y z : Int) (h : bfOmin x y = some z) :
    x = some z ∨ z = y := by
  cases x with
  | none =>
    right
    have h1 : some y = some z := h
    have h2 := Option.some_inj.mp h1
    omega
  | some a =>
    have h1 : some (min a y) = some z := h
    have h2 : min a y = z := Option.some_inj.mp h1
    rcases min_choice a y with hm | hm
    · left; rw [← h2, hm]
    · right; rw [← h2, hm]

theorem bf_relax1_le (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v u : Nat)
    (acc : Option Int) : bfOLe (bfRelax1 g d v u acc) acc := by
  unfold bfRelax1
  cases hdu : d.getD u none with
  | none => simp; exact bf_OLe_refl acc
  | some du =>
    cases hc : bfEdgeW g u v with
    | none => simp; exact bf_OLe_refl acc
    | some c => simp; exact bf_omin_le_left acc (du + c)

theorem bf_foldr_le_init (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    ∀ (L : List Nat) (init : Option Int), bfOLe (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init) init := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro init; exact bf_OLe_refl init
  | cons u L ih =>
    intro init
    simp only [List.foldr_cons]
    exact bf_OLe_trans (bf_relax1_le g d v u _) (ih init)

theorem bf_foldr_le_elem (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat)
    (u : Nat) (du c : Int) (hdu : d.getD u none = some du) (hc : bfEdgeW g u v = some c) :
    ∀ (L : List Nat) (init : Option Int), u ∈ L →
      bfOLe (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init) (some (du + c)) := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro init h; simp at h
  | cons y L ih =>
    intro init h
    simp only [List.foldr_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with hy | hy
    · subst hy
      have : bfRelax1 g d v u (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init)
          = bfOmin (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init) (du + c) := by
        unfold bfRelax1; rw [hdu, hc]
      rw [this]
      exact bf_omin_le_right _ _
    · exact bf_OLe_trans (bf_relax1_le g d v y _) (ih init hy)

theorem bf_foldr_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    ∀ (L : List Nat) (init : Option Int) (x : Int),
      L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init = some x →
      init = some x ∨ ∃ u ∈ L, ∃ du c, d.getD u none = some du ∧ bfEdgeW g u v = some c ∧
        x = du + c := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro init x h; left; simpa using h
  | cons y L ih =>
    intro init x h
    simp only [List.foldr_cons] at h
    cases hdu : d.getD y none with
    | none =>
      rw [show bfRelax1 g d v y (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init)
            = L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init by unfold bfRelax1; rw [hdu]] at h
      rcases ih init x h with h1 | ⟨u, hu, rest⟩
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr ⟨u, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu, rest⟩
    | some dy =>
      cases hc : bfEdgeW g y v with
      | none =>
        rw [show bfRelax1 g d v y (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init)
              = L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init by unfold bfRelax1; rw [hdu, hc]] at h
        rcases ih init x h with h1 | ⟨u, hu, rest⟩
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨u, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu, rest⟩
      | some cy =>
        rw [show bfRelax1 g d v y (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init)
              = bfOmin (L.foldr (bfRelax1 g d v) init) (dy + cy) by
                unfold bfRelax1; rw [hdu, hc]] at h
        rcases bf_omin_sound _ _ _ h with h1 | h1
        · rcases ih init x h1 with h2 | ⟨u, hu, rest⟩
          · exact Or.inl h2
          · exact Or.inr ⟨u, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu, rest⟩

theorem bf_len (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : ∀ k, (bfIter g start k).length = g.size := by

  cases k with
  | zero => simp [bfIter, bfInit]
  | succ k => simp [bfIter, bfStep]

theorem bf_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hstart : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (x : Int), (bfIter g start k).getD v none = some x →
      ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ p.length ≤ k + 1 ∧

  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v x h
    by_cases hv : v < g.size

      by_cases hvs : v = start
      · subst hvs
        simp at h
        refine ⟨[v], bf_isPath_single g v, by simp, by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
        rw [bf_weight_single]; omega
      · simp [hvs] at h
    · rw [bfIter, bfInit, bf_getD_map_range_ge _ _ _ (by omega)] at h
      simp at h
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v x h
    by_cases hv : v < g.size
    · rw [bfIter, bfStep, bf_getD_map_range _ _ _ hv, bfRelaxAt] at h
      rcases bf_foldr_sound g (bfIter g start k) v _ _ _ h with h1 | ⟨u, hu, du, c, hdu, hc, hx⟩
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hlen, hw⟩ := ih v x h1
        exact ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, by omega, hw⟩

        obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hlen, hw⟩ := ih u du hdu
        obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := bf_getLast_concat p u hl
        have hed : g.has_edge u v c := bf_edgeW_sound g u v c hun hc
        have hpv : g.is_path (u :: [v]) := by
          rw [bf_isPath_cons2]; exact ⟨⟨c, hed⟩, bf_isPath_single g v⟩

          exact ⟨c, 0, hed, (bf_weight_single g v 0).mpr rfl, by ring⟩

        · rw [bf_getLast?_append_cons]; simp

theorem bf_stab (g : WeightedGraph) (start k : Nat)
    (heq : bfStep g (bfIter g start k) = bfIter g start k) :
    ∀ m, bfIter g start (k + m) = bfIter g start k := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    show bfStep g (bfIter g start (k + m)) = bfIter g start k
    rw [ih, heq]

-- Proof content
theorem bellman_ford_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) :
    bellman_ford_postcond graph start
      (bellman_ford graph start h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hstart, hbd⟩ := h_precond
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ graph.size := by omega
  have hnm : graph.size - 1 + 1 = graph.size := by omega
  unfold bellman_ford
  split_ifs with hfix
  · -- No improvement in the |V|-th round: the distances are the shortest ones.
    simp only [bellman_ford_postcond]
    refine ⟨bf_len graph start _, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    -- optimality over walks of arbitrary length
    have hopt : ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), graph.is_path p → p.head? = some start →
        p.getLast? = some v → graph.path_has_weight p w →
        ∃ d, (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none = some d ∧ d ≤ w := by
      intro p w hp hh hl hw
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := bf_opt graph start hwf hstart (graph.size - 1 + p.length) p v w
        hp hh hl (by omega) hw
      rw [bf_stab graph start (graph.size - 1) hfix p.length] at hd
      exact ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩
    cases hvd : (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none with
    | none =>
      simp only
      rintro ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := bf_weight_exists graph p hp
      obtain ⟨d, hd, _⟩ := hopt p w hp hh hl hw
      rw [hvd] at hd
      simp at hd
    | some d =>
      simp only
      constructor
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, _, hw⟩ := bf_sound graph start hwf hstart (graph.size - 1) v d hvd
        exact ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hw⟩
      · intro p w hp hh hl hw
        obtain ⟨d', hd', hdw⟩ := hopt p w hp hh hl hw
        rw [hvd] at hd'
        simp at hd'
        omega
  · -- Some distance still improves: extract a negative cycle.
    simp only [bellman_ford_postcond]
    -- find a witness index
    have hlen1 : (bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))).length = graph.size := by
      simp [bfStep]
    have hlen2 : (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).length = graph.size := bf_len graph start _
    have hex : ∃ v, v < graph.size ∧
        (bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none
          ≠ (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hfix (bf_list_ext_getD _ _ (by omega) (fun v hv => hc v (by omega)))
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hne⟩ := hex
    -- the new value is `some b0`
    have hstepv : (bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none
        = (List.range graph.size).foldr (bfRelax1 graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)) v)
            ((bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none) := by
      rw [bfStep, bf_getD_map_range _ _ _ hv, bfRelaxAt]
    have hle : bfOLe ((bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none)
        ((bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none) := by
      rw [hstepv]; exact bf_foldr_le_init _ _ _ _ _
    obtain ⟨b0, hb0⟩ : ∃ b0, (bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none
        = some b0 := by
      cases hs : (bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1))).getD v none with
      | some b0 => exact ⟨b0, rfl⟩
      | none =>
        exfalso
        cases ho : (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)).getD v none with
        | none => rw [hs, ho] at hne; exact hne rfl
        | some a0 =>
          obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := hle a0 ho
          rw [hs] at ha; simp at ha
    -- every walk to v of at most graph.size vertices is strictly worse than b0
    have hno : ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), graph.is_path p → p.head? = some start →
        p.getLast? = some v → p.length ≤ graph.size → graph.path_has_weight p w → b0 < w := by
      intro p w hp hh hl hplen hw
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := bf_opt graph start hwf hstart (graph.size - 1) p v w hp hh hl
        (by omega) hw
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := hle d hd
      rw [hb0] at ha
      simp at ha
      have : b0 ≠ d := by
        intro hcon
        rw [hb0, hd, hcon] at hne
        exact hne rfl
      omega
    -- soundness at round graph.size gives an actual walk of weight b0
    have hiter : bfIter graph start graph.size
        = bfStep graph (bfIter graph start (graph.size - 1)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hnm]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPh, hPl, hPlen, hPw⟩ :=
      bf_sound graph start hwf hstart graph.size v b0 (by rw [hiter]; exact hb0)
    have hPn : P.length = graph.size + 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      have : P.length ≤ graph.size := by omega
      exact absurd (hno P b0 hP hPh hPl this hPw) (by omega)
    -- pigeonhole
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ P, x < graph.size := bf_verts_lt graph hwf P start hP hPh hstart
    have hnd : ¬ P.Nodup := by
      intro hcon
      have := bf_nodup_bound P graph.size hmem hcon
      omega
    obtain ⟨A, x, B, C, hdec⟩ := bf_not_nodup_decomp P hnd
    have hdec' : P = A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) := by
      rw [hdec, List.append_assoc]; rfl
    subst hdec'
    -- split off the prefix A
    obtain ⟨w1, w2, hpA, hwA, hpR, hwR, hsum1⟩ :=
      bf_split_path graph A x (B ++ x :: C) b0 hP hPw
    -- split the remainder into the cycle and the tail

    rw [hrew] at hpR hwR
    obtain ⟨wc, w3, hpC, hwC, hpT, hwT, hsum2⟩ :=
      bf_split_path graph (x :: B) x C w2 hpR hwR
    -- the shortened walk
    obtain ⟨hpS, hwS⟩ := bf_join_path graph A x C w1 w3 hpA hwA hpT hwT
    have hSh : (A ++ x :: C).head? = some start := by
      rw [bf_head?_append_cons, ← bf_head?_append_cons A x (B ++ x :: C)]
      exact hPh
    have hSl : (A ++ x :: C).getLast? = some v := by
      rw [bf_getLast?_append_cons]
      rw [bf_getLast?_append_cons A x (B ++ x :: C), hrew, bf_getLast?_append_cons] at hPl
      exact hPl
    have hSlen : (A ++ x :: C).length ≤ graph.size := by
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hPn ⊢
      omega
    have hlt := hno (A ++ x :: C) (w1 + w3) hpS hSh hSl hSlen hwS
    -- hence the cycle is negative
    refine ⟨(x :: B) ++ [x], wc, hpC, ?_, ?_, hwC, by omega⟩
    · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      omega
    · have h1 : ((x :: B) ++ [x]).head? = some x := by simp
      have h2 : ((x :: B) ++ [x]).getLast? = some x := by
        rw [bf_getLast?_append_cons (x :: B) x []]
        simp

  -- !benchmark @end proof
